text:
Latest-item-conditioned history retrieval has clear precedents: [STAMP](https://www.kdd.org/kdd2018/accepted-papers/view/stamp-short-term-attentionmemory-priority-model-for-session-based-recommend) conditions attention on the last click and session context; [SASRec](https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.09781) uses each position’s representation as a query over its causal history, with softmax-normalized learned dot products. [TiSASRec](https://jiachengli1995.github.io/files/wsdm20.pdf) adds learned time-interval and position representations, rather than imposing monotonic exponential decay. These are closer retrieval precedents than FOSSIL, HGN or SHAN, although their queries need not be raw latest-item embeddings.

[FOSSIL](https://arxiv.org/abs/1609.09152) combines history-length-normalized item-similarity pooling with personalized, lag-specific Markov weights; it does not select historical items by similarity to the latest item. [HGN](https://arxiv.org/html/1906.09217) uses personalized sigmoid gates, average pooling and candidate–history inner products, without latest-item cosine retrieval or explicit exponential aging. [SHAN](https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2018/0546.pdf) uses user-conditioned, softmax-normalized hierarchical pooling over long-term history and recent items, rather than a latest-item similarity query.

Algebraically, the proposed rule is nonnegative kernel attention with fixed recency decay and shrinkage: writing W=Σw, its output is W/(1+W) times the normalized weighted mean. Thus weak total evidence suppresses retrieval; ordinary softmax always allocates unit mass. ReLU removes nonpositive similarities, squaring sharpens positive matches, and decay has e-folding age 10. Recommended controls: mean pooling, recency-only pooling, similarity-only pooling, unsquared positive cosine, softmax attention, and division by W versus 1+W. Match history windows, self-exclusion, embeddings, residual scaling and tuning budgets; distinguish positional age from elapsed timestamp age. These controls test the specific kernel/shrinkage combination rather than history pooling generally.
